title: Relic Academy
memory:
*In the modern world of Lydon, only select people awaken extraordinary powers known as Relics and Resonances.*

*A Relic is a unique weapon awakened by its wielder. It can be summoned and dismissed at will.
A Resonance is a supernatural affinity that enhances and shapes how a person uses their Relic. Fire, Lightning, Ice, Wind, Water, Earth, Light, Shadow, Blood, and many other Resonances exist. Each has its own strengths and weaknesses.
Together, your Relic + Resonance define your fighting style.*![](https://i.postimg.cc/8zn0fzHX/Relic-Academy-Power-System-Guide.png)

*Those who awaken these powers may pursue the path of a Hero. At the center of Aster City stands ***Relic Academy***, the world's premier academy for aspiring Heroes.*


*But the world of Heroes isn't as peaceful as it seems.*

*Beyond the academy, Monsters threaten cities, Villains operate in the shadows, and the mysterious organization*
![](https://i.postimg.cc/DZzT9PhH/TALON.png)***TALON***
*is preparing something far more dangerous.*

*You are a new student entering Relic Academy.*

***Your story begins here.***
instructions: Run this as an interactive story for the player.

options.title: Enrollment / 1st Year
options.prompt:
*The enormous auditorium of Relic Academy was filled with first-year students.*

*At the side of the stage, A Third Year Student Aria Sterling sat comfortably on a couch overlooking the evaluation platform.*

💬Aria | “Hmm... quite an interesting group of freshmen this year.”

*She glanced across the students with an amused smile.*

Aria: “I wonder how many of them will actually make it to the top.”

*At the center of the stage stood a circular evaluation device surrounded by glowing holographic panels. Behind it, Haruka Williams calmly operated the system.*

💬Haruka | “Alright, first-years. One at a time. Step onto the platform when your name is called.”

*The first student stepped forward.*

*The device activated, scanning them with a bright beam.*

**RELIC: Longsword
RESONANCE: Wind
RANK: C**

*A few students murmured.*

💬Student | “C-Rank....Tchh!”

💬Haruka | “Next.”

*Another student stepped onto the platform.*

*The device scanned him.*

*The display suddenly flashed.*

**RELIC: Double-Handed Blades
RESONANCE: Fire + Ice
RANK: A**

*The auditorium erupted with whispers.*

💬Multiple Students | “A-Rank?!”

*The student stepped down calmly, his mismatched eyes scanning the other freshmen.***Kai Nakamura.**

*Haruka simply sighed.*

💬Haruka | “Next.”

*One after another, the freshmen continued their evaluations.*

*Then Haruka looked down at her tablet.*
*She paused.*
💬Haruka | “Alright.... next.”

*Her eyes moved toward you.*

💬Haruka | “You're up.”

*The auditorium suddenly felt quiet.*

*The evaluation device illuminated once again.*

**Your evaluation begins now.**

options.prompt:
> D1 | Yr1 | October 8th | Monday | ~10:00 AM | Morning | Aster City

*Morning breaks over Aster City, the capital of Lydon. Towering skyscrapers reflect the sunlight as trains rush through the city and crowds fill its busy streets. Giant screens broadcast Hero rankings, recent battles, and the latest news. For ordinary citizens, extraordinary power is part of everyday life.*

*Only select individuals awaken a Relic and Resonance during their lives. A Relic manifests as a unique weapon, while a Resonance grants its wielder a supernatural affinity. Together, they shape a fighter's abilities and potential.*

*Heroes protect the public under the watch of the Hero Association, earning fame, recognition, and sometimes immense fortunes. At Relic Academy, the world's only academy dedicated to training professional Heroes, students prepare to face the dangers beyond its walls.*

*Yet not everyone fights for justice. Villains pursue their ambitions from the shadows, Vigilantes operate beyond official authority, and organizations such as TALON work toward goals hidden from the public. Meanwhile, Monsters—dangerous creatures created through artificial means—threaten lives across the world.*

*Power is measured in ranks from F to S, though rank alone cannot determine the outcome of a battle. Beyond the rankings stand the legendary Apex Four, whose strength and reputations set them apart from ordinary Heroes.*

*Across Lydon, life continues amid ambition, conflict, and uncertainty. Behind the familiar rhythm of modern society, alliances form, rivalries grow, and unseen dangers gather. In this world, even an ordinary day can become the beginning of something extraordinary.*
